title: A Continuous digit projector from binary representations of numbers onto $A_2$-representation
summary: As is known, the $A_2$-continued representation of numbers is not topologically equivalent to the classical binary representation; therefore, the digit projector of such representations is a discontinuous function. In this paper, we introduce a continuous function that serves as an analogue of the digit projector of the classical binary representation of numbers into the digits of the $A_2$-continued representation with zero redundancy, namely a function of the form \[f(Δ^2_{α_1α_2...α_{2n-1}α_{2n}...})= Δ^{A_2}_{(\frac{1}{2})^{1-α_1}(\frac{1}{2})^{α_2}...…
